CHAPTER 7
CONCLUSION
7.1 Conclusion
Rapid advancements of digital communication technologies and financial services over
the Internet have made cyber-enabled frauds and phone scams more dangerous.
Fraudsters use increasingly sophisticated approaches including ID spoofing, VoIP
Speech API, and ML tools proves that there is an opportunity to develop scalable and
lightweight systems for scam detection based on the use of contemporary web
technologies. In addition, the PWA design pattern ensures good accessibility and
enables cross-platform deployment without complex setup.
CHAPTER 8

need to continually improve upon scam detection technology. Though TrueShield AI
proves to be an effective way to deploy the use of Artificial Intelligence, semantic
8.3 Deepfake Voice Detection
The development of AI-enabled fake speech technology is one of the new challenges
that cybersecurity must contend with. Hackers require just a few seconds of an audio
clip to replicate human voices in their scamming activities via telephone.
8.5 Telecom-Level Integration
Currently, the framework operates as an application to detect scams at the user level.
In the coming days, however, the framework can easily integrate itself into the
telecom infrastructure and network communications.
8.7 Advanced Behavioural Analysis
Presently, scam detection is done by analysing the language of speech and making
sense of it. However, future systems can incorporate techniques that enable
behavioural analysis to enhance accuracy in detecting fraud cases.
In the future, it will be possible to add such features to the program as follows:
• Simulations of scams for educational purposes
• Cybersecurity education powered by AI
• Suggestions for preventing scams
These include:
• Federated learning
• Homomorphic encryption
• Differential privacy
